name: fW World Championship
epitaph: No champion is recorded for the fW World Championship in the surviving record — the fed's own champions page still read the unfilled template's own “Wrestler Name” in every slot, under both the champion and all three contenders, at its last capture, 6 March 2003.
notes: Recovered from the fed's own champions page (promotions/fortune-fwrestling/archive/champions-2003-03.html), captured 6 March 2003.
